samples.question: Four ordered panels are shown left to right. Each panel draws the same horizontal track divided into six slots by thin divider lines. A red token and a green token each occupy exactly one slot in every panel, and each token keeps its own fixed color as it moves between slots. In the first (leftmost) panel the two tokens are in different slots. Read the panels left to right and report the earliest panel (P2, P3, or P4) at which the red token and the green token occupy the same slot. Answer 'panel 2', 'panel 3', or 'panel 4'.
